Author: SunnysOfficial
Name: Venue Mapper
Description: A Dalamud plugin for discovering FFXIV venues with 2D/3D interactive markers, live events, and built-in owner tools. Your complete FFXIV venue guide.
Changelog:
## Hotfix v0.5.7.1

- Fixed: Venue map no longer shows when standing in garden or outdoor housing area
- Fixed: Venue map no longer shows in non-housing zones (e.g. Limsa Lominsa)
- Fixed: Empyreum housing district now detected correctly in all house types
- Improved: Housing detection fully rewritten using HousingManager API - no hardcoded territory IDs
